description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeTargetHTTPProxy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeTargetHTTPProxy spec.

description.description: Immutable. An optional description of this resource.

httpKeepAliveTimeoutSec.description: Immutable. Specifies how long to keep a connection open, after completing a response, while there is no matching traffic (in seconds). If an HTTP keepalive is not specified, a default value (610 seconds) will be used. For Global external HTTP(S) load balancer, the minimum allowed value is 5 seconds and the maximum allowed value is 1200 seconds. For Global external HTTP(S) load balancer (classic), this option is not available publicly.

location.description: Location represents the geographical location of the ComputeTargetHTTPProxy. Specify a region name or "global" for global resources. Reference: GCP definition of regions/zones (https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/regions-zones/)

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

proxyBind.description: Immutable. This field only applies when the forwarding rule that references this target proxy has a loadBalancingScheme set to INTERNAL_SELF_MANAGED.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

urlMapRef.description: A reference to the ComputeURLMap resource that defines the mapping from URL to the BackendService. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeURLMap resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/urlMaps/{{urlMapID}}" or "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/urlMaps/{{urlMapID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeURLMap resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeURLMap resource.

title: GCP Compute ComputeTargetHTTPProxy
